help_language: Set your preferred language for bot replies.
help_nation_found: [GM] Create and assign a nation: /nation found <player> <name> <history>
help_nation_stats: View a nation's stats. Leave name blank to see your own.
help_nation_history: View a nation's public history log.
help_nation_history_add: [GM] Add a manual history entry to a nation.
gm_only: This command requires the Game Master role.
generic_error: Something went wrong. Please try again or ask a Game Master for help.
nation_already_exists: You already have a nation: **{nation}**. Each player may only found one.
nation_name_taken: The name **{name}** is already taken. Please choose another.
nation_not_found: Nation not found. Check the spelling and try again.
history_empty: No history entries found for **{nation}** yet.
nation_list_empty: No nations have been founded yet.
help_province_info: View details of a single province by Azgaar cell ID.
help_province_list: List all provinces owned by a nation.
help_province_claim: [GM] Claim provinces for a nation using cell IDs (e.g. 1,2,5-10).
help_map_import: [GM] Import an Azgaar JSON export to populate the province database.
help_map_resync: [GM] Re-import an updated Azgaar export, merging with existing ownership.
province_not_found: No active province found with cell ID {cell_id}.
province_bad_ids: Invalid ID format. Use comma-separated IDs and/or ranges e.g. 1,2,5-10.
province_claimed: Claimed {claimed} province(s) for **{nation}**. ({not_found} ID(s) not found.)
help_map_export_markers: [GM] Generate a JS snippet to place resource markers on your Azgaar map.
no_nation: You do not have a nation yet. Ask the Game Master to create and assign one to you.
help_resources: View your nation resource stockpile and treasury.
help_build: Construct a building in one of your provinces.
help_buildings_list: List all available building types with costs and effects.
help_buildings_prov: List buildings currently in a specific province.
help_mp_propose: Propose a megaproject for GM approval.
help_mp_list: List all megaprojects (optionally filtered by nation).
help_admin_tick: [GM] Manually trigger the daily resource tick.
help_building_set: [GM] Edit a building definition field live.
help_building_new: [GM] Add a new custom building type.
build_not_owner: Your nation does not own that province.
build_unknown: Unknown building type: {key}. Use /buildings list to see options.
build_already_exists: {building} is already built in that province.
